items.title: Restore both App architecture ratchets through cohesive objective-frame and input-diagnostics extraction.
items.why: The executable receipt fails at 5088 total lines and a 1787-line game-loop span. The live Dynamic Objective reward block remains inline, while InputDebugOverlay and formatting are presentation code embedded in App. Raising the 5000/1775 budgets would make the gate dishonest.

Move InputDebugOverlay plus finite formatting into its own component. Preserve reward values, objective histories, achievements, rendering copy, and input diagnostic semantics. items.title: Turn the local Unified Genius List from an age-only title cache into an honest executable-work contract.
items.why: The cache marks anything under Now or Deferred as generic work, even titles tagged BLOCKER, Human/Data, product decision, or community readiness. It emits no status/final score and --check only tests a 24-hour mtime, so task-board changes can leave stale priorities. The current six-item cache therefore cannot prove exhaustion or guide /implement safely.

Emit schema v2 items with status, reason, source section, SIL escalation, axis, score components, and deterministic finalScore. Classify device/data/credential/publication/product-decision work as non-executable without inventing blockers. Make freshness compare input mtimes or digests for TASK_BOARD, SIL, PROJECT_STATUS, STUDIO_BRAIN, and GENOME_HISTORY. Add fixtures for every status, default limits, stale inputs, and deterministic ordering; innovation-pack must exclude non-executable items while retaining an honest deferred ledger.

L2.recipe: Add deterministic scoring, shared classification, and input-aware freshness with fixtures.

L3.recipe: Ship a schema-v2 control surface consumed consistently by cache, router, innovation pack, and saturation receipts with no fabricated padding.
